mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 260.0 and decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% indicates a stagflationary environment where central banks ease policy to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to eroding real returns.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL>260.0 and FEDFUNDS<0.1% fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units signals an impending slowdown in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST falls below 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index rises above 260.0, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts central banks to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 260.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 141700 thousand and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.9% indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS<141700 and UNRATE>7.9% fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 537000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS falls below 537000.
